notes.note: Stewart was 100% efficient with his 19 disposals this week as he spent time with Sheezel and Curtis.
Stewart was amongst the best for the Cats with his 10 marks and 20 disposals.
Stewart posted the third best score for the Cats and his fourth over 90 in a row from 25 touches and 6 marks. He was good down back and played the floating interceptor role well.
Stewart was the top scorer in the game with 11 of his 25 touches being intercepts. This was his third best score of the season.
22 touches at 81% for Stewart to go with 7 marks. A solid showing from the defender backing up his good score from last week.
Stewart was solid with his 18 disposals at 100% efficiency. His best game since round 10.
Tom returned this week and had himself 25 disposals but the efficiency was down which did slow his scoring a little.
15 touches for Stewart as he didn't look himself in the wet conditions. He isn't the safe bet we are used to as he has had more than a few low scores this season.

Stewart was one of the better scoring Cats with his 21 disposals coming at 95% and he had 9 contested possessions. It was a tougher night than expected for him as the Blues forwards were putting on plenty of pressure.
Stewart hasn't been able to put games over 100 in a row since rounds 3 and 4. He had 17 touches this week with just 2 tackles.
Stewart is the key to the Cats. 7 marks and 28 disposals at 89% for the defensive star.  This was his second best score for the season.
Stewart had 21 touches in his 200th game as he did have Ned Long playing a bit of a forward tag on him.
This is now three under 65 in the last four for Tom which is a concern for owners. Just 14 disposals and 5 marks for him.
Stewart had 22 kicks to go with 5 handballs to be the best scorer for the Cats. His first over 100 in the last three.
This is now two quiet games in a row from Stewart which is a concern for those holding him. For those that don't have him his price should be very affordable shortly.
Very quiet day by Tom's standards with his first score under 110 for him this season and by a big distance. His price will drop for a couple of weeks with this in his cycle.
Stewart was the epitome of a loose man and was allowed to do as he pleased with 21 kicks 6 marks and 9 intercept possessions.
If it wasn't for the injury risk Stewart would have been in more teams. 10 marks for him to go with his 27 disposals. If he stays healthy he could be a play for us.
Stewart was one of the better scorers for the Cats but select with caution as we know he can miss through injury at any point.
